_comment: Expectations for the demonstration scenario — a real /wf:branch FAKE-1 run against the scripted fake providers. Structural expectations only; the status_ere and required_ops are SHAPE checks, never a transcript prose exact-match. min_pass_rate is the per-assertion variance threshold: 1.0 requires every run to satisfy the family (a below-threshold pass rate is a REGRESSION; a family that varies but stays at/above threshold is DRIFT).
